instruction.text: Convert this sentence from the passive voice to the active voice.

hint.text: In the active voice, the verb 'to be' is removed from the sentence and the other verb is in the past tense.

atoms.a: This tree was planted by my grandmother.
The birthday candle was blown out by Andy.
The letter was written by Molly.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap to convert the sentence from the passive voice to the active voice.

atoms.a: The hamster was taken to the vet by Hope.
atoms.b: Hope ((took)) the hamster to the vet.

atoms.a: The bike was ridden to school by the two boys.
atoms.b: The two boys ((rode)) the bike to school.

atoms.a: The Tower of London was built by William the Conqueror in 1078.
atoms.b: William the Conqueror ((built)) the Tower of London in 1078.
